propositions: The test deterministically fails on hosts with scc or lizard installed because it does not control metric tool availability while asserting a metric coverage record is always present.
The 50-LOC fixture is below the 800-LOC threshold, so when scc/lizard is found on PATH, _metric_invoke returns no match and emits no metric record, causing reconstruction to omit the backend.

The sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already uses explicit missing-metric-tool fixture control to ensure host independence; the full-account test was missing this same control.
Adding _METRIC_CANDIDATES fixture control to force a missing executable will make the test deterministic and prove the metric backend appears as visible skipped coverage with reason no_tool.
Production grounding behavior and evidence schema semantics must remain unchanged; a metric tool run with no threshold match must not fabricate or abstract a false record.
